name: approved
description: The PR meets the defined quality standards and best practices.

name: not approved
description: The review identified significant issues or deviations from standards.

name: not reviewed
description: The review could not be performed or completed successfully.

name: changes-requested
description: Changes have been requested by a human reviewer.

name: ci-failure
description: Indicates that one or more CI checks or AI processes have failed.

name: ai-reviewed
description: Indicates that the PR has been processed by an AI agent.

name: bug
description: Something isn't working.

name: enhancement
description: New feature, request, or improvement to existing functionality.

name: frontend-improvement
description: Visual or interactive improvement to the user interface.

name: refactor
description: Restructuring code without changing behavior.

name: chore
description: Internal maintenance, dependency updates, or build process changes.

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation.

name: scope:focused
description: PR touches a single architectural area.

name: scope:needs-review
description: PR touches multiple architectural areas and requires careful review.

name: priority:high
description: High priority issue or PR.

name: priority:medium
description: Medium priority issue or PR.

name: priority:low
description: Low priority issue or PR.

name: needs-info
description: More information is needed from the author.

name: stale
description: No activity has been detected for a long time.

name: duplicate
description: This is a duplicate of another issue or PR.

name: wontfix
description: This will not be worked on.

name: invalid
description: The issue or PR is invalid or doesn't follow guidelines.

name: bot-generated
description: Issue or PR generated automatically by a bot.

name: triage-needed
description: This issue needs to be reviewed and prioritized.

name: automerge
description: Indicates that the PR should be automatically merged when all checks pass.

name: auto-code
description: Triggers automated coding agents (e.g., Gemini Coder).
